build_interpretation: Initial Mac nine-step build compiled both changed core units, both updated fixtures, header-dependent refresh fixtures, library and both executables (6.534s). Final five-step build followed canonical hidden-policy preparation and expanded inherited-issue tests (4.597s); tests 1.119 s.

Linux and Windows verify the same 117-file manifest before builds and stop before CTest on failure. All current case markers and source hashes match; executable hashes and timestamps are retained. Final build/test seconds 7.627/0.272 and 13.819/2.459 respectively.

Focused clean compiles cover the same 35-unit set as the acquisition milestone, with 11 additional cases and no cached objects. Current Mac/Linux/Windows build seconds 73.088/162.432/69.077; previous 151.455/159.675/68.533.

The previous Mac 151.455 s build had observed load about 80 on 10 CPUs; current observed load about 46. Timing difference was reviewed against commands, all 35 source units, current hashes, successful links and test markers. Load may contribute but is not proof of causation. No elapsed-time-only freshness claim is made.
guarantees: Refresh result retention is explicit and validated; default release behavior remains unchanged. Exact retained scan directory, generation, sealed held rows and issues pass into acquisition.

Already-held rows preserve family/revision and make no acquisition I/O, including when explicitly requested again. Their metadata is canonical from the held object and hidden policy is prepared for the requested model.
Union of existing held rows and matched requested rows reserves handle capacity before any new native opens. Hard-link names remain separate slots.
Inherited issue count and name bytes are bounded; issue copying uses preparation steps/time slices. Original states/codes survive later successful initial acquisitions.
Only final pane publication can preserve selected rows through sealed continuity; replacements and failed/unqualified continuity remain invalidated.
New acquisition retains existing cancellation/fault/retirement behavior. No intermediate pane publication, original-path reopen, mutation or content read is introduced.
limitations: The composed result consists of live observations at different times, not a simultaneous membership/content snapshot or operation authorization.
No UI scheduler, immutable UI projection or execution-time revalidation is implemented by this stage. Native-owner lifetime remains worker-owned.
Count/name-byte limits bound separate representations, not total process memory or guaranteed OS handle capacity. Native calls can block beyond cooperative slices.
WP-01 remains open for self/descendant safety, native name equivalence, operation-specific capabilities, remaining inventories, large-view indexes and UI/worker integration. WP-02 not started.
